description: This Java class defines an immutable strategy for handling the PolicyIdCreated event within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract class to implement specific behavior when a PolicyIdCreated event occurs, updating a ThingBuilder with the new policy ID.

classes.name: PolicyIdCreatedStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that defines how to handle the PolicyIdCreated event by updating a ThingBuilder instance with the event's policy ID.

methods.name: PolicyIdCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the PolicyIdCreatedStrategy class, protected to restrict instantiation.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to apply the PolicyIdCreated event to a ThingBuilder, setting its policy ID based on the event data.
